spans.text: That was easier than I thought... Did the enemies not have time to set up too many defenses...?
Maybe I should just seize the controls...
RO! RO, wake up!
What is it...? I'm not completely done yet...
The white enemies! They're making their way towards us!
Have they discovered our location...?
Sheesh. Your guardian angel already told you not to touch that control panel.
Those morons laid such a pathetic trap and the prey that fell for it wasn't the rabbit they're after... This is turning out to be quite an amusing day.
A...forced transmission?!
Who are you?!
The rabbits are gonna get roasted if they don't start running.
I never give away information for free, but I'll make an exception for you this time – you can pay me later.
The transmission...is coming from a hidden passage in the sewers?
If you leave now, you might still make it out alive. It'd make my life a lot more difficult if you kicked the bucket just like that.
Are you our informant? Where are you?!
Dammit, the signal has already disappeared...
What do we do now? That was him, wasn't it? If we retreat now, everything we've done today would've been for nothing!
In any case, we've got to move right now...
If the white enemies have this room surrounded, it'll really be game over.
Commander, you still there? I'm really sorry but we require immediate support!
There's a special passage that can help us evade the enemies as we enter the sewers. Please cover our retreat!
And SOP-II, hand over your dog!
Dog? You mean Banana?
I don't care what it's called... I need to borrow it to retrace the informant's signal.
If he could force a connection with us, he can't be far from here.
We still have some time before the Commander's forces arrive. I won't let our efforts be in vain!
